create your Own Private Tour

There are many good companies with many packaged tours that will take you to the highlights of Vietnam.  But our goal at Little Vietnam Tours is different.  You should experience Vietnam your way.  One of our local select Vietnamese experts will meet with you, understand how you want to spend your time, share our honest opinions and suggestions of the best places to visit in Vietnam, and plan your own guided Vietnam private tour for you and with you.

Then we plan and book all the details--hotels, transportation, activities and many of the meals.  We'll also meet you personally when you arrive and are available throughout your trip to make sure your trip goes smoothly with all the things to do in Vietnam. You'll have your own private local guide, selected for their personality, wide knowledge and genuine enthusiasm. Informative, professional but down to earth with a real passion for showing you the very best places to visit in Vietnam.

We'll design a personalized tour for you--you decide where you go, how you travel, the pace, number of days, type of lodging experience, food and drink experience, and how you want to interact with your guide.

​That's what makes Little Vietnam Tours the best Vietnam tour company, and why our clients trust us with their holiday!

Choose Your Vietnam experience

Everyone likes to travel their own way.  Little Vietnam Tours will help you design a personalized itinerary for your vacation/holiday just how you want it.  We'll make all the arrangements and pay attention to all the details.

Step One:  Check out these popular itineraries and destinations and see what interests you most.
Step two:  Contact us and we'll personalize a guided tour just for you based on your preferences.
​

Classic Sightseeing

Cruise the natural beauty of Ha Long Bay, visit hill tribes villages of Sapa, historical temples of Hue, 1000 year old floating markets in the Mekong Delta, experience the culture, countryside & charm.
View Classic Tours

Beach / Relaxing

Stay at extreme luxury resorts & villas in Nha Trang, relax on white sand beaches of Phu Quoc,  romantic candlelight dinners on the beach, snorkel/dive the best coral reef in Nha Trang, pamper yourself at Danang's luxury spas.
Relaxing Tours

WILDLIFE

Search for Vietnam's famous langurs at Cat Tien National Park, bird watching & bird sanctuaries in the Mekong Delta, get off the beaten bath and into remote areas.
Wildlife Tours

Families & Small Children

We specialize in family tours and activities.  Family travel in Vietnam can mean slowing down, enriching & fun activities for children, we know the best family-friendly hotels that make traveling with children better.
Ideas for Families

Adventure

Trekking through rice paddies in Sapa, meeting hill tribe women in Ha Giang, kayaking Ha Long Bay, hiking Cat Ba Island, wandering the old quarter of Hanoi, have a beer on Bia Hoi corner, row a sampan through Ninh Binh.
Adventure Itineraries

Food & Drink

Street food tours in the Mekong Delta, try Asia's unique fruits, local food markets, cooking classes in Hoi An.  Bun Cha, the best Pho, Banh Mi,
​Che dessert, and Hue's renowned cuisine!
the best Food Tours

Vietnam welcomes travelers

Vietnam officially re-opened its borders in April 2022 to welcome visitors following the pandemic.  In 2023, Vietnam modified its immigration policies making it even easier for visitors to visit with an e-visa program.  You can read about and apply for an e-visa here.   Citizens of 20 European countries including the UK, are now exempted from a visa for a 45-day stay in Vietnam while citizens from the US, Australia and all other countries can now easily apply for an eVisa online through a simple process!
​Follow this link to apply:
https://evisa.gov.vn/​
From April 15, 2026, travelers from all countries arriving through Tan Son Nhat Airport in Ho Chi Minh City must complete a pre-arrival immigration form within 3 days before departure at https://prearrival.immigration.gov.vn .   This new procedure is designed to streamline the immigration process even further.  Little Vietnam Tours has learned of other "fake" links circulating the internet, so be sure to use the official government link above.  We at Little Vietnam Tours are happy to answer any questions you have about entry requirements, precautions and logistics to make your upcoming travel safe and hassle free.

get off the beaten path...

Many travelers simply want to see the highlights of Vietnam and its culture.  Others want to get off the beaten path in Vietnam.  Some do both.  We can weave these off-the-beaten-path adventures into one unforgettable vacation tour just for you:

Immerse yourself in real local life in beautiful remote villages in such as Ha Giang, or the more visited Sapa.   Travel to the rugged north to witness Ban Gioc falls, listed as one of the most beautiful waterfalls in the world.  Travel west to Pongour and Elephant falls in Vietnam's most romantic city of Dalat.   Venture to the amazing Son Doong cave, with the world's largest cross-section passage, only surveyed in 2009 and opened in 2013 to very few visitors.  Bike through Vietnam's unspoiled countryside, and treat yourself to inexpensive spa treatments--every day if you wish.

We know the best places to visit in Vietnam, and we'll take you there on your own Vietnam private tour.
